name: When should I consider a home addition instead of just remodeling existing space?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a home addition instead of just remodeling existing space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider a home addition when your current space no longer meets your needs and remodeling within the existing footprint isn't enough. This might be due to a growing family, the desire for a dedicated home office, or needing more living area. An addition often involves more extensive planning, permitting, and a larger budget than internal remodeling. It's a significant decision, and we can help you assess if an addition is the right solution for your long-term goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider an addition if existing space is insufficient after remodeling. It involves more planning and a larger budget.
